name: Acceptance suite-3 test 84 - short-form 12-digit account principal stays valid
note: IAM-1004 (Phase 10) Campaign D: a bare 12-digit account id (111122223333) is the short form of arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root and delegates trust to the whole account - a VALID cross-account delegation. It carries no glob, so it must NOT be misclassified as an invalid ARN (no TRUST-INVALID-PRINCIPAL, no INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN). The original short form is preserved in evidence.
